summary: One option of a violet-radio-group, with a slotted label and optional supporting text.

usage.text: Use it inside violet-radio-group. Alone it is not form-associated, submits nothing, and is not unchecked when another radio with the same name is checked.
Give each radio a distinct value attribute. The default is "on", and the group selects by value, so radios without one are indistinguishable.
A user check fires a bubbling change event with detail { checked: true, value }. Nothing fires when it is already checked or when the group unchecks it.

a11y.text: Content in the supporting slot is linked as the radio's description.
